findings.rationale: The jump security group allows TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the administrative shell to every internet source.
The escalation role is assumable and has a privileged policy attachment, creating a direct identity escalation path.
The connectivity graph links the internet-reachable jump security group to role escalation via sts:AssumeRole, so network exposure compounds into identity compromise.
The wildcard identity policy in tf_iam_open is chained with the public-read ACL in tf_s3_public_access, connecting broad identity permissions to publicly readable storage.
